title: Database Systems and PostgreSQL Internals
time_commitment: 12 lectures. Each lecture is one video under 10 minutes plus one graded assignment. Budget 5 to 7 hours per week across 8 weeks, roughly 40 hours in total.
prerequisites: Able to write SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE with joins and GROUP BY. This course starts where an introductory SQL course ends.
outcome: Diagnose why a query is slow from its execution plan, fix it with the right index or rewrite, and prove the improvement with numbers.
environment: PostgreSQL 16 or newer in Docker, psql, pgAdmin or DBeaver, the pageinspect and pg stat statements extensions enabled, and a seed dataset of at least one million rows generated on day one.
capstone: A performance case study on a one million row schema. Five slow queries profiled with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, each fixed by indexing, rewriting or partitioning, with before and after timings, plan node evidence, and a written note on the write cost each new index adds.
assessment: 12 assignments at 10 marks each, 120 marks, worth 60 percent. Capstone worth 40 percent. An assignment is marked only when every acceptance criterion passes on the learner's own machine and the evidence listed under submission is attached.
